title: Customer Pulse — Microthemes & Actionable Requests (Nov 2025)
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is a lightweight synthesis of short customer conversations and support threads (Oct 20 — Nov 2, 2025). Goal: surface tight microthemes (recurring pain points + small-to-medium feature asks) that are high signal and quickly actionable by Product/Eng. This is deliberately terse — use as input for next CS->Product sync.

Methodology:
- Sources: 18 CS triage threads, 6 post-onboarding interviews, 4 account escalations, 12 support tickets.
- Inclusion: repeated ask from at least 2 customers OR high-impact single-customer escalation.
- Quick triage: each microtheme has ~1 line suggested approach, rough impact/effort, and an initial owner suggestion.

Microthemes (ranked by frequency x impact heuristic)
1) Predictable token-cost visibility on streaming responses
- Problem: customers report difficulty forecasting per-request spend when using streaming endpoints (partial tokens billed, sudden cost spikes on long-lived streams).
- Example quote: "We can’t show finance accurate estimates because streaming bills feel opaque — need per-stream breakdown."
- Suggested approach: Add per-stream estimated token and final token breakdown to usage logs and a streaming mode flag that returns token-estimates in initial response headers.
- Impact: high. Effort: medium (API + billing telemetry). Owner: product-hosted-api.

2) SDK automatic backoff + faster fallback to cheaper model variants
- Problem: heavy tail latency events cause product outages; customers want automatic fallback to a smaller compatible model to preserve SLOs.
- Ask: built-in SDK policy to fallback within X ms and route to pinned cheap variant.
- Suggested approach: propose SDK flag "graceful_fallback_policy" + server-side routing policy that supports a cost tier fallback.
- Impact: high reliability. Effort: medium-high (runtime + SDK + routing). Owner: eng-serving-runtime + developer-experience.

3) Fine-grained per-route quotas and alerts for embeddings-heavy workloads
- Problem: some customers run heavy batched embedding jobs that unexpectedly consume quota causing downstream failures.
- Ask: per-route daily token caps + proactive alerting when consumption approaches cap.
- Suggested approach: console feature + automated email/Slack alerting.
- Impact: medium. Effort: low-medium. Owner: product-console.

4) Better diffs for model rollouts (textual, not only metrics)
- Problem: customers want to see representative sample diffs (prompt -> modelA vs modelB) alongside metric deltas during canary/A-B. Currently only numeric metrics shown.
- Suggested approach: add sampled response diffs with highlight of changed tokens, and tie to eval prompt set.
- Impact: high for safety-conscious customers. Effort: medium. Owner: product-rollouts, research-applied-ml.

5) Autoscaling / burst behavior visibility for Dedicated pools
- Problem: customers unsure whether a spike will trigger burst capacity or be throttled; this is blocking some committed capacity sales.
- Ask: explicit documented burst rules + per-pool historical burst usage graph in Console.
- Suggested approach: docs + Console chart + simulation modal.
- Impact: sales enabling. Effort: low. Owner: product-dedicated + observability.

6) Faster onboarding snippet for private deployments (network checklist)
- Problem: private/VPC installs fail on basic networking/hsm settings; onboarding time lengthens.
- Ask: one-page network checklist with common failure modes and debugging commands.
- Suggested approach: one-pager + sample terraform module.
- Impact: medium. Effort: low. Owner: solutions-engineering.

7) Batching suggestion engine in Optimize product for variable-length workloads
- Problem: customers with bursty short/long sequences don’t know optimal max_batch_size or latency SLO trade-offs.
- Ask: near-instant recommendation tuned to observed sequence length histograms.
- Suggested approach: rollout an Optimize pilot that ingests 48h traces and suggests profile + expected cost delta.
- Impact: cost reduction for customers. Effort: medium. Owner: product-optimize + infra.

8) Embeddings versioning / lineage metadata in Console
- Problem: customers struggle to know which embedding model & preprocessing were used for stored vectors (regulatory + reproducibility).
- Ask: attach embedding model id + tokenizer hash + date to index entries and expose via Console/Query API.
- Suggested approach: storage schema change + console display.
- Impact: compliance & trust. Effort: medium-high. Owner: product-hosted-api + storage.

One-off escalations (high urgency but narrow)
- ACME ads platform: needs per-request deterministic retry-id to dedupe streamed completions (ticket JIRA-ENG-12987). Proposed short-term patch: add optional client-generated id header used for idempotency on completion events. Owner: sres+platform.

Customer quotes & color (short snippets)
- "When a model update hits, we need a way to audit what changed in the outputs — the numeric metrics aren’t enough." — large fintech
- "Streaming is great but we can’t afford surprises on monthly bills. Need predictable estimates." — ML infra lead at marketplace
- "Our legal team insists on embedding lineage for audits; otherwise we can’t certify long-term retention." — healthcare startup

Quick prioritization attempt (for Product review)
- Fix now (<8 weeks): per-stream token visibility, per-route quotas + alerts, Dedicated burst rules doc.
- Plan & prototype (8–16 weeks): SDK fallback policy, model rollout diffs, embeddings lineage.
- Backlog (Q1 2026+): Optimize batching suggestion engine full pilot.

Immediate next steps (CS -> Product handoff)
- Schedule 30m sync with Product-Hosted-API and Eng-Serving (target: Nov 17) — action: Rita to set meeting.
- Create JIRA epic for "streaming cost visibility" (tentative JIRA-STREAM-502). Diego to draft acceptance criteria and sample payloads.
- Solutions-engineering to assemble 2-page private deployment network checklist and post to Confluence; link in onboarding emails. Hannah to lead.

Open questions / notes to self
- Need a cost telemetry spike: can Billing produce per-stream estimates cheaply or do we rely on sampled post-hoc aggregation? (ask billing team)
- How much routing policy complexity are we okay surfacing in SDKs vs keeping server-side? (discuss with runtime)
- For rollout diffs: do we auto-sample by percentile or allow customer-specified prompt sets? (default to eval-linked sets)

Attachments & pointers
- Quick tally of sources (ticket ids + customer initials) included in Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/FEEDBACK-2025-11
- Prototype console chart mock (Figma link): https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/streaming-cost-mock
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/621

Status: draft — looking for Product owners to pick 2 high-impact items to run discovery.

Rita — customer-success (cc: Diego, Hannah, Amir)
